name: Get campaign calendar
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the list of dates on which campaigns occurred within a specific date range for reporting purposes. Use a detailed campaign report action instead when you need metrics or performance data for those campaigns.

startDate.description: Start of the date range (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End of the date range (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.description: A date on which at least one campaign was sent.

dates.description: Array of campaign dates within the requested range.
